title: FlexiWorld: Learning and Planning via Flexible Action Chunks Across Multiple Time Scales
abstract: arXiv:2609.35138v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Latent world models predict future states for goal-directed planning using action chunks spanning multiple primitive steps. Existing methods typically use fixed-length chunks and either omit goal-conditioned action generation or limit their supervision to short goal spans. We introduce FlexiWorld, a JEPA-based world model that combines mixed-span goal supervision with variable-length action chunks to improve long-horizon control. During training, we sample varying goal spans and randomly partition the actions into variable-length chunks. We jointly train the world model with a causal action encoder that embeds variable-length chunks and an autoregressive actor that generates primitive actions sequentially. Student Forcing reduces exposure bias by training on generated action prefixes. For planning, Actor-Residual Cross-Entropy Method (ARCEM) combines action-residual search with within-chunk autoregressive feedback and chunk-boundary

translated_title: FlexiWorld：通过跨多时间尺度的灵活动作块进行学习与规划
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通过跨越多个原始步骤的动作块来预测未来状态，以实现目标导向的规划。现有方法通常使用固定长度的动作块，并且要么忽略目标条件下的动作生成，要么将监督限制在较短的目标跨度内。我们提出了FlexiWorld，这是一种基于JEPA的世界模型，它将混合跨度的目标监督与可变长度的动作块相结合，以提升长时程控制能力。在训练过程中，我们采样不同的目标跨度，并将动作随机划分为可变长度的动作块。我们将世界模型与一个嵌入可变长度块的因果动作编码器以及一个顺序生成原始动作的自回归Actor进行联合训练。Student Forcing通过在生成的动作前缀上进行训练来减少曝光偏差。在规划方面，Actor-Residual交叉熵方法（ARCEM）将动作残差搜索与块内自回归反馈以及块边界（处的选择）相结合。
tldr: FlexiWorld是一种基于JEPA的世界模型，通过混合跨度目标监督与可变长度动作块，结合Student Forcing减少曝光偏差以及ARCEM规划方法，显著提升了长时程控制性能。
en_tdlr: FlexiWorld is a JEPA-based world model that combines mixed-span goal supervision with variable-length action chunks, leveraging Student Forcing to reduce exposure bias and ARCEM for planning, thereby improving long-horizon control.
